notes: §2002:12.2.6.2 SR10 'Literal-4 and literal-9 shall be alphanumeric or national literals': at --std 2002 a numeric literal-4 (LOCALE L1 IS 123) and a numeric literal-9 (ORDER TABLE OT1 IS 5) are each refused COBOL5987 at the clause, and alphanumeric/national literal-4 with an alphanumeric literal-9 compile and run (EQ== / LEN=1 per §2002:15.69.3 RV6, RV7), matching the derivation.
